title: RARE K-POP DEMON HUNTERS DERPY CAT WITH SUSSIE UNMARKED PVC FIGURE 3" INCHES
descriptionText: This rare 3-inch PVC figure features a derpy cat with a sussie, perfect for fans of K-POP and collectors of unique action figures. The vintage piece from China showcases intricate details and is part of the K-POP franchise, making it a must-have for any enthusiast of pop culture memorabilia. This unmarked figure is a one-of-a-kind addition to any action figure collection, particularly for fans of K-POP and cat-themed merchandise.
